narration:1:1061001001:0.text: The outskirts of Holistone are as peaceful as ever, until a girl falls from the sky...
narration:1:1061001001:0.source_cn: 圣石镇郊野一如往常的平静，直到一位少女从天而降，打破平静……
narration:1:1061001001:0.male: The outskirts of Holistone are as peaceful as ever, until a girl falls from the sky...
narration:1:1061001001:0.female: The outskirts of Holistone are as peaceful as ever, until a girl falls from the sky...

say:7:1061001005:0.text:
No way...
Don't tell me that gate sent us to different places!
say:7:1061001005:0.source_cn: 难道说……\n刚才那扇门把我们传送到了不同的地方？

say:8:1061001006:0.text: This is the middle of nowhere! How am I supposed to find my way back alone?!

narration:10:1061001008:1.text: After a moment, the girl begins to collect herself.

say:12:1061001009:0.text: Okay... okay. Panicking's not gonna help. First thing's first—gotta check out the area.

say:13:1061001010:0.text: I was just practicing my Celestial Spirit Magic... The gate opened like usual, but Aquarius never showed.
say:13:1061001010:0.source_cn: 呼……本来在练习星灵魔法，结果星灵之门虽然打开了，但不...

say:14:1061001011:0.text: Weird... Did my magic mess up? Or did something happen to her?! I definitely sensed her magic earlier. I never should've jumped through that gate...
say:14:1061001011:0.source_cn: 奇怪……难道是我的星灵魔法有问题吗？还是说……阿葵亚失...

say:15:1061001012:0.text: I can't feel any other Celestial Spirit's magic here. Looks like my other Spirit Keys won't work either...
say:15:1061001012:0.source_cn: 这里完全感知不到其他星灵的魔力，看样子其他星灵钥匙也没...

say:16:1061001013:0.text: No, get it together, Lucy! You've fought dragons, dark guilds, and Erza's wrath! You can handle this!
say:16:1061001013:0.source_cn: 没关系的露西，一起和同伴经历了那么多，你已经变强了！就...

say:17:1061001014:0.source_cn: 很好！就用这股气势前进吧！

narration:18:1061001015:1.text: Lucy walks ahead on her own for a while...
narration:18:1061001015:1.source_cn: 露西独自往前走了一会……

say:20:1061001016:0.text: Not even a single signpost... Seriously, where am I?
say:20:1061001016:0.source_cn: 连个可以问路的人都没看见……

say:25:1061001020:1.text: Huh? Are you talking to me? Do you speak, like... words?
say:25:1061001020:1.source_cn: 呃……你是在跟我讲话吗？能用我听得懂的语言吗？

say:27:1061001022:1.text: Whoa, whoa! Don't suddenly get so close!
say:27:1061001022:1.source_cn: 喂喂！别突然靠这么近啊！！

say:29:1061001024:1.text: You're attacking me! Oh no you don't!
say:29:1061001024:1.source_cn: 想攻击我？那我就不客气了！

say:32:1061001026:0.text: Wait, I can't summon any spirits right now...
say:32:1061001026:0.source_cn: ……等等，我现在叫不出任何星灵……

say:35:1061001029:1.text:
In that case...
Time to run!

say:44:1061001035:0.text: Lucy! Fancy running into you here!

say:46:1061001037:0.text: Wait, what are you doing here?
say:46:1061001037:0.source_cn: 等等……为什么你会在这里？

say:47:1061001038:0.text: Oh, I came to ask you if you wanted to take on a job. But then I saw this weird gate where you were... I heard you yelling from inside it, so I dove in!
say:47:1061001038:0.source_cn: 哦！我是去找你约任务的，结果发现你在的地方有扇奇怪的门...

say:49:1061001040:1.text: Gone! I jumped in right before it vanished. Pretty cool, huh?
say:49:1061001040:1.source_cn: 关闭了！我是趁它消失前最后一刻跳下去的！嘿嘿。

say:50:1061001041:1.text: What?! What do we do now... How are we supposed to get back?!
say:50:1061001041:1.source_cn: 什么！这可怎么办……我们该怎么回去啊！

say:51:1061001042:1.text: By the way, Lucy—where are we, exactly?
say:51:1061001042:1.source_cn: 话说回来，露西你来这里干什么？这是哪？

say:52:1061001043:1.text: You tell me! I was trying to summon Aquarius, but she never showed up. Instead, that gate appeared.
say:52:1061001043:1.source_cn: 我也不清楚这是哪里……我只是想叫出阿葵亚，谁知道她没有...

say:53:1061001044:0.text: Any idea where to find her, Natsu? Got any leads?
say:53:1061001044:0.source_cn: 要去哪里找阿葵亚，纳兹，你有头绪吗？

say:55:1061001046:0.text: But if we keep moving forward, we'll figure something out!
say:55:1061001046:0.source_cn: 但继续前进，总能找到方向吧！

narration:58:1061001049:1.source_cn: 纳兹的出现，让露西分外安心……

narration:59:1061001050:1.source_cn: 两人并肩穿过陌生的郊野，不知徒步了多久，二人来到了一个...

say:61:1061001051:0.source_cn: 不知道这里有没有魔导士公会，如果有公会帮忙，那找阿葵亚...

say:62:1061001052:0.text: Only one way to find out!

say:66:1061001054:0.text: Do you know where the local Mage Guild is?

say:68:1061001056:0.text: Huh? You don't have one here?

say:69:1061001057:0.source_cn: 魔导士，就是能够用魔法战斗的人啊！

say:70:1061001058:0.text: And a guild is like a big family! Like <style="stress">Fairy Tail</style>!
say:70:1061001058:0.source_cn: 公会，就是一个大家庭！比如<style=stress>...

Can't say I've heard of it, but I do know what mages are!

say:33:1061002027:0.source_cn: 今天我叫水瓶座星灵阿葵亚的时候失败了，而本该出现的星灵...

say:34:1061002028:0.text: I'm really worried about her. I need to find her quickly!
say:34:1061002028:0.source_cn: 我有点担心阿葵亚，希望能尽快找到她！

say:36:1061002029:0.text: What does Lady Aquarius look like?
say:36:1061002029:0.source_cn: 阿葵亚阁下的特征是什么？

say:38:1061002031:0.text: Since she's a mermaid, she's probably somewhere with water.
say:38:1061002031:0.source_cn: 因为是人鱼，所以她可能会待在有水的地方。

say:39:1061002032:0.text: Water, you say? That could be important.
say:39:1061002032:0.source_cn: 有水的地方？这或许是个关键线索？

say:40:1061002033:0.text: There's a lake near Holistone, but we've never seen a mermaid there.
say:40:1061002033:0.source_cn: 圣石镇附近也有湖面，但我们可从没见过外形是人鱼的女性。

say:51:1061002036:0.text: Hey! Good to hear from you, but this really isn't a good time!
say:51:1061002036:0.source_cn: 老朋友！很高兴你联系我，但现在不是时候！
say:51:1061002036:0.male: Hey! Good to hear from you, but this really isn't a good time!
say:51:1061002036:0.female: Hey! Good to hear from you, but this really isn't a good time!

say:52:1061002039:0.text: I've been chasing this prize fish for weeks, and I'm this close to catching it!
say:52:1061002039:0.source_cn: 眼前这条肥美的大鱼被我盯上很久了，我就快要追上它了！

choice_prompt:53:1061002039.text: I've been chasing this prize fish for weeks, and I'm this close to catching it!
choice_prompt:53:1061002039.source_cn: 眼前这条肥美的大鱼被我盯上很久了，我就快要追上它了！

say:54:1061002040:0.text: Mermaid? Nope, can't say I've seen one of those lately... But folks around Rustport have been going on about a sea dragon, whipping up waves like mad!
say:54:1061002040:0.source_cn: 人鱼我可没什么印象，不过最近倒是出现一条海龙，卷起的风...

say:55:1061002041:0.text: Gotta go! If I lose this fish, my client will have my hide! Later!
say:55:1061002041:0.source_cn: 抱歉，我得挂了！要是鱼跑了，我可没办法跟雇主交代！回见！

say:58:1061002042:0.text: Whoa! You've got dragons here too?
say:58:1061002042:0.source_cn: 海龙，这个世界也会有龙？

say:60:1061002043:0.text: "Sea dragon" is just sailor talk—could mean anything big and dangerous in the water.
say:60:1061002043:0.source_cn: 海龙只是行话，不一定是龙，也许是海里的其他巨兽。

say:63:1061002046:1.text: She's really powerful, but if it's by chance an actual dragon... I'm still worried.
say:63:1061002046:1.source_cn: 虽然阿葵亚很强，但对方如果真是龙的话……还是有点担心她。

say:64:1061002047:0.text: Then what are we waiting for? Let's go find her and head home together!
say:64:1061002047:0.source_cn: 那就这么定了，去找到阿葵亚，然后我们一起回家吧！

say:66:1061002049:1.male: Then it's decided. If you're set on Rustport, <style="stress"><player_name></style> should accompany you. We'll keep things secure here.
say:66:1061002049:1.female: Then it's decided. If you're set on Rustport, <style="stress"><player_name></style> should accompany you. We'll keep things secure here.

narration:69:1061002051:1.text: The trio boards the creaking ship bound for Rustport. Before the sails even catch wind, Natsu's legs give out—he faceplants onto the deck with a thud that shakes the mast, limbs splayed like a starfish.
narration:69:1061002051:1.source_cn: 你和露西、纳兹三人乘上了前往锈锚港的船，纳兹上船后，就...
narration:69:1061002051:1.male: The trio boards the creaking ship bound for Rustport. Before the sails even catch wind, Natsu's legs give out—he faceplants onto the deck with a thud that shakes the mast, limbs splayed like a starfish.
narration:69:1061002051:1.female: The trio boards the creaking ship bound for Rustport. Before the sails even catch wind, Natsu's legs give out—he faceplants onto the deck with a thud that shakes the mast, limbs splayed like a starfish.

narration:70:1061002052:2.text: Days later, the ship docks at the port where Sinbad awaits. Natsu staggers onto solid ground, pale but relieved.
narration:70:1061002052:2.source_cn: 几日后，船停靠在锈锚港港口，辛巴达早已在码头等待大家，...

say:73:1061002054:0.text: Natsu, how are you holding up?

say:75:1061002056:0.text: Haha! That's the spirit! Ready to sail again?
say:75:1061002056:0.source_cn: 哈哈，非常好，看起来我们马上可以出海了？

say:77:1061002058:0.text: Well, you didn't call the legendary Sinbad for a pleasure cruise!
say:77:1061002058:0.source_cn: 当然，你们找我不就为了这个吗？

say:78:1061002059:0.text: Maybe you should sit this one out, Natsu...
say:78:1061002059:0.source_cn: 纳兹，你还是先休息下吧。

say:79:1061002060:0.text: No way! I said I'd help, and I will! Seasick or not, I'm not backing down!
say:79:1061002060:0.source_cn: 怎么可能休息！我说过是来帮忙的！虽然坐上船会有点晕……

say:80:1061002061:0.text: Heh. You're green as kelp but still keeping your word. I respect that.
say:80:1061002061:0.source_cn: 脸色都和死鱼一样了还要遵守约定，很有毅力嘛。
say:80:1061002061:0.male: Heh. You're green as kelp but still keeping your word. I respect that.
say:80:1061002061:0.female: Heh. You're green as kelp but still keeping your word. I respect that.

narration:82:1061002062:0.text: You explain the full story of Lucy and Natsu's origins...
narration:82:1061002062:0.source_cn: 向辛巴达交代了露西和纳兹的来历……

say:84:1061002063:0.text: Heh. Figures you'd be tangled up in something like this, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You never fail to find the most fascinating companions!
say:84:1061002063:0.male: Heh. Figures you'd be tangled up in something like this, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You never fail to find the most fascinating companions!
say:84:1061002063:0.female: Heh. Figures you'd be tangled up in something like this, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You never fail to find the most fascinating companions!

say:85:1061002064:0.text: That said, those waters are crawling with rumors of a sea dragon.
say:85:1061002064:0.source_cn: 不过话可说在前面，这海域可有海龙的传闻。

say:86:1061002065:0.source_cn: 无论如何，我们抓紧时间，先出海吧，具体的船上再说。

narration:87:1061002066:1.text: Sinbad takes the helm with a cocky grin, steering you straight toward the rumored sea dragon's domain...
narration:87:1061002066:1.source_cn: 辛巴达利落地带我们扬帆起航，船驶向海龙出没的地方……

say:94:1061002038:0.text: No response... Your friend must be busy.
say:94:1061002038:0.source_cn: 没人回话……老师的朋友一定在忙吧。

choice:14:0:1.text: A pleasure to meet you both.
choice:14:0:1.male: A pleasure to meet you both.
choice:14:0:1.female: A pleasure to meet you both.

say:96:1061002013:0.text: It's more than a guild, really—when you join, you become family. Right, Natsu?
say:96:1061002013:0.source_cn: 只要加入了公会，就成了同伴。对吧，纳兹？

say:97:1061002014:0.text: You got it! Guildmates are people you'd trust with your life.
say:97:1061002014:0.source_cn: 没错，同伴是可以互相托付生命的存在！

say:98:1061002007:0.text: I've been following your journey from afar, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:98:1061002007:0.source_cn: 虽然是有段日子没见了，但我一直在注视<style=st...
say:98:1061002007:0.male: I've been following your journey from afar, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:98:1061002007:0.female: I've been following your journey from afar, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:99:1061002008:0.text: Ah, these two require your aid.
say:99:1061002008:0.source_cn: 今天的主角不是我，这两位朋友找你帮忙。
say:99:1061002008:0.male: Ah, these two require your aid.
say:99:1061002008:0.female: Ah, these two require your aid.

choice:9:1:2.text: Valen. Still keeping busy, I see.
choice:9:1:2.male: Valen. Still keeping busy, I see.
choice:9:1:2.female: Valen. Still keeping busy, I see.

say:100:1061002009:0.text: They're not from this world. They came here looking for someone, hoping your expertise could point the way.
say:100:1061002009:0.source_cn: 他们来自异世界，来这找人，想让你帮个忙。
say:100:1061002009:0.male: They're not from this world. They came here looking for someone, hoping your expertise could point the way.
say:100:1061002009:0.female: They're not from this world. They came here looking for someone, hoping your expertise could point the way.

narration:0:1061003001:2.text: The moment you leave port, Natsu's eyes glaze over—yet he keeps muttering about fighting...
narration:0:1061003001:2.source_cn: 一上船，纳兹就双眸失神，但嘴里还念叨着要战斗……

say:7:1061003004:1.text: Brace yourselves, we're nearing the sea dragon's waters.
say:7:1061003004:1.source_cn: 就快驶进有海龙的海域了，再坚持一下吧。

say:9:1061003005:1.text: W-why are those ships firing at us?!

say:11:1061003006:1.text: Let 'em. With me steering? I'm gonna turn them into firewood.
say:11:1061003006:1.source_cn: 不用担心，有辛巴达船长在。等着吧，看我撞飞他们！

say:12:1061003007:0.text: Wait—you're not dodging?! You're ramming them?!
say:12:1061003007:0.source_cn: 什么，不是甩开而是撞飞吗？！！！

narration:15:1061003008:0.text: After a thunderous boom, Sinbad sets sail and rams the ship that fired on us—leaving a huge hole in its hull...
narration:15:1061003008:0.source_cn: 一声巨响后，辛巴达开船把炮轰我们的船撞了个大洞……

say:17:1061003009:0.text: Relax! After that kraken incident, I had Hugin reinforce this beauty. She can take anything!
say:17:1061003009:0.source_cn: 别怕，上次被海怪袭击后，我特意找呼金加固了船体，我们的...

say:18:1061003010:1.text: Looks like they're boarding. I'll handle the bow. You two, keep the rest off my ship!
say:18:1061003010:1.source_cn: 那艘船上的人跳上来了！趁现在，把碍事的人干掉吧，我盯着...

say:20:1061003011:1.text: Natsu! Come on, wake up! We need you!
say:20:1061003011:1.source_cn: 纳兹……纳兹！醒醒，要战斗了！

say:23:1061003013:0.text: Tch. The kid's down for the count—too seasick to even swing a punch.
say:23:1061003013:0.source_cn: 啧，这小子已经晕船到不省人事了。

say:24:1061003014:0.text: Looks like it's up to you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:24:1061003014:0.male: Looks like it's up to you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:24:1061003014:0.female: Looks like it's up to you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:27:1061003015:0.text: Listen up, you bilge rats! By Lord Borut's decree, these waters are closed to dragon hunters! Now hand over your loot, or else!
say:27:1061003015:0.source_cn: 船上的听着！我们受伯特兰老爷的命令，封锁这片海域！任何...

say:29:1061003016:0.text: If you don't cough it up, we'll ram you into the seabed!
say:29:1061003016:0.source_cn: 他奶奶的！不交钱！撞船这事没完！

say:30:1061003017:0.source_cn: 小的们，冲！看到什么拿什么！

say:36:1061003020:0.text: Hold it! One more step and the girl gets it!
say:36:1061003020:0.source_cn: 住手！不然我就要她的命！

say:40:1061003022:0.text: I, uh... tried sneaking around behind them. Bad idea.
say:40:1061003022:0.source_cn: 那个，我想绕到后面偷袭，但失算了……

say:41:1061003023:0.text: Heh heh. One wrong move, and she's fish food. Now fork over the gold!
say:41:1061003023:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，不想让她受伤的话就把钱交出来！

say:44:1061003024:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your friend's a mage, right? Why's she just standing there?
say:44:1061003024:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your friend's a mage, right? Why's she just standing there?
say:44:1061003024:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your friend's a mage, right? Why's she just standing there?

say:45:1061003025:0.text: I'm a Celestial Spirit Mage! But I only brought one key today and... my spirit's gone...
say:45:1061003025:0.source_cn: 我是星灵魔导士！可我……我只带了一把星灵之钥……能召唤...

say:46:1061003026:0.text: Don't move, little missy. This blade's itching for a taste!
say:46:1061003026:0.source_cn: 喔哟，小姑娘不要乱动哦，我的刀可不长眼睛！

say:50:1061003028:0.source_cn: 啊，你是什么时候冒出来的！

say:52:1061003030:0.text: Pfft. Pathetic seasick wimp. Stay down.
say:52:1061003030:0.source_cn: 原来是个软脚虾，滚一边去！

say:53:1061003031:0.source_cn: 可恶……不许！不许伤害露西！

say:56:1061003033:1.text: Aquarius! If you can hear me, come forth!
say:56:1061003033:1.source_cn: 阿葵亚！如果你在附近，请聆听我的呼唤，现身吧！！！

narration:59:1061003034:1.text: The sky darkens, and the sea suddenly erupts in a massive whirlpool.
narration:59:1061003034:1.source_cn: 阴沉的天空下，海面卷起了骇人的风浪……！

say:62:1061003035:1.text: Wh-What the—?! It's the sea dragon! ABANDON SHIP!!!
say:62:1061003035:1.source_cn: 风浪……这风浪不对！是海龙！海龙出来了！快跑！

say:64:1061003036:0.text: Aw, what's wrong? Thought you were hunting dragons, not running from a splash.
say:64:1061003036:0.source_cn: 哟，你们不是来猎龙的吗？怎么海龙出来就要逃了？

say:65:1061003037:0.text: Better swim fast! That dragon must be hungry!
say:65:1061003037:0.source_cn: 跑快点啊，海龙要追上你们喽！

narration:67:1061003038:0.text: The pirates abandon ship in complete panic as Sinbad taunts them...
narration:67:1061003038:0.source_cn: 在辛巴达的调侃下，海盗们像下饺子一样争先恐后跳入水中……

say:69:1061003039:0.text: Pathetic. Honestly, I'm embarrassed for them.
say:69:1061003039:0.source_cn: 真是不禁吓啊……从这里游回锈锚港恐怕够呛，愿风浪与漂泊...

choice_prompt:70:1061003039.text: Pathetic. Honestly, I'm embarrassed for them.
choice_prompt:70:1061003039.source_cn: 真是不禁吓啊……从这里游回锈锚港恐怕够呛，愿风浪与漂泊之神保佑他们。

say:75:1061003041:1.text: Aquarius! Thank goodness we found you!
say:75:1061003041:1.source_cn: 阿葵亚！太好了，找到你了！

say:76:1061003042:1.text: How many times do I have to say it? Don't interrupt my vacation!
say:76:1061003042:1.source_cn: 说过多少次了，不要来打扰我的假期！

say:77:1061003043:0.text: Are you here to clear your head? No wonder the Celestial Spirit Gate you opened led here... but why couldn't I summon you?
say:77:1061003043:0.source_cn: 你是来散心的吗？怪不得召唤你的星灵之门通向了这里……但...

say:78:1061003044:0.text: I guess you could say that. I got pulled here by some kind of strange magic, and the scenery turned out to be pretty nice, so I wasn't in a hurry to return to the Spirit World.
say:78:1061003044:0.source_cn: 算是散心吧，我无意间被某种力量传送到这里，没想到这里风...

say:79:1061003045:0.text: I knew something was off! Even though Aquarius is strong, I still couldn't help but worry—so I came after you...
say:79:1061003045:0.source_cn: 果然是出了意外！虽然阿葵亚很强，但我还是担心你，就跟着...

say:83:1061003047:0.text: So you're the sea dragon those pirates were after? Huh. Gotta say, first time I've seen a mermaid scarier than an actual dragon.
say:83:1061003047:0.source_cn: 所以海盗们在找的海龙就是你？哇，第一次见到比海龙还要强...

say:85:1061003049:0.text: I meant... more powerful! Very majestic! Ten out of ten!

say:88:1061003050:0.text: Aquarius, Natsu and I promised to go home together once we found you. Let's head back now!
say:88:1061003050:0.source_cn: 阿葵亚，我和纳兹约好找到你就一起回家。现在我们可以一起...

say:89:1061003051:0.text: That brat came too? Where is he?

say:90:1061003052:0.text: Huh? He was right next to me—
say:90:1061003052:0.source_cn: 纳兹……？刚刚还在这里的呀……

choice_prompt:91:1061003051.text: That brat came too? Where is he?

say:92:1061003053:1.text: Natsu! I have to save him!

say:97:1061003056:0.text: She actually jumped in?! That takes guts!
say:97:1061003056:0.source_cn: 这妹子，不会也跳下海了，真勇敢啊！

say:99:1061003057:0.text: Right! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, lower the anchor! I'll get them!
say:99:1061003057:0.male: Right! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, lower the anchor! I'll get them!
say:99:1061003057:0.female: Right! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, lower the anchor! I'll get them!

choice:91:0:1.text: He may be in the sea.
choice:91:0:1.male: He may be in the sea.
choice:91:0:1.female: He may be in the sea.

choice:32:0:1.male: (Use wind magic to blast them back)

say:5:1061004003:0.text: Thank you all, really. Not just for helping us find Aquarius, but for taking such good care of us.
say:5:1061004003:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们，不仅帮忙找到了阿葵亚，还盛情款待我们……

choice_prompt:6:1061004003.text: Thank you all, really. Not just for helping us find Aquarius, but for taking such good care of us.
choice_prompt:6:1061004003.source_cn: 谢谢你们，不仅帮忙找到了阿葵亚，还盛情款待我们……

say:7:1061004004:1.text: Without your help... I honestly don't know how we would've made it.
say:7:1061004004:1.source_cn: 如果不是遇到你们，真难想象我们该怎么办。

say:8:1061004006:1.text: Lucy! Try these glowy fruits! They're crazy good!
say:8:1061004006:1.source_cn: 露西！来尝尝这盘亮晶晶的果子！

say:9:1061004007:1.text: Whoa, what is this flavor?! We don't have anything like this back in Fiore!
say:9:1061004007:1.source_cn: 唔……美味！这果子叫什么，我们那边没见过。

say:10:1061004008:0.text: They're glowfly fruit. <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed us how to magically enhance their flavor.
say:10:1061004008:0.male: They're glowfly fruit. <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed us how to magically enhance their flavor.
say:10:1061004008:0.female: They're glowfly fruit. <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed us how to magically enhance their flavor.

say:11:1061004009:0.text: We better eat as many as we can—no way we're finding these back home!
say:11:1061004009:0.source_cn: 这么难得，那要多吃点！回去可就吃不着了！

say:12:1061004010:1.text: Let's pack some for the guild!
say:12:1061004010:1.source_cn: 我们可以带一些回公会给其他人尝尝。

say:13:1061004011:1.text: Guild? Oh right—I was going to find you for a job.
say:13:1061004011:1.source_cn: 公会？说起来我本来是叫你一起去做任务的……

say:14:1061004012:1.text: And I told Happy to meet us there! He's probably worried sick!
say:14:1061004012:1.source_cn: 我告诉哈比在公会集合的，他还在那等着我们呢！

say:15:1061004013:1.source_cn: 露西，我们要去找哈比！别让它担心！

say:17:1061004015:1.text: Wait! At least let me thank everyone properly! Especially <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:17:1061004015:1.source_cn: 等一下，至少让我向大家表达一下感谢！尤其是<style...
say:17:1061004015:1.male: Wait! At least let me thank everyone properly! Especially <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:17:1061004015:1.female: Wait! At least let me thank everyone properly! Especially <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:18:1061004016:1.text: Things could've gone so wrong today... but thanks to all of you, they didn't.
say:18:1061004016:1.source_cn: 今天，多亏了你们，一切都有惊无险。

say:19:1061004017:1.text: Natsu and I will never forget your kindness.
say:19:1061004017:1.source_cn: 我和纳兹，非常感谢大家！

say:20:1061004018:1.text: Yeah! Not only did we find Aquarius, but we ate like kings!
say:20:1061004018:1.source_cn: 对，不仅顺利找到了阿葵亚，还能吃到这么好吃的东西！

say:21:1061004019:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the best! You might not wear our mark, but you're Fairy Tail through and through!
say:21:1061004019:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the best! You might not wear our mark, but you're Fairy Tail through and through!
say:21:1061004019:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the best! You might not wear our mark, but you're Fairy Tail through and through!

say:22:1061004020:1.text: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!
say:22:1061004020:1.source_cn: 没错，等我们回去了也会告诉大家，在伊索米亚的大陆上，有...
say:22:1061004020:1.male: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!
say:22:1061004020:1.female: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!

choice_prompt:23:1061004020.text: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!
choice_prompt:23:1061004020.source_cn: 没错，等我们回去了也会告诉大家，在伊索米亚的大陆上，有个叫<style=stress><player_name></style>的大魔法师，是个了不起的好人！
choice_prompt:23:1061004020.male: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!
choice_prompt:23:1061004020.female: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!

say:24:1061004021:1.text: *Sigh* Yeah... I know we only just met, but... it's already hard saying goodbye.
say:24:1061004021:1.source_cn: 唉……明明才认识不久，一想到要和你们说再见，总觉得很不...

say:25:1061004022:0.text: You should come visit our world sometime!
say:25:1061004022:0.source_cn: 什么时候也来我们的世界玩吧！

say:26:1061004023:1.text: The guild would love to have you!

say:27:1061004024:1.text: Actually... I've been curious about something...
say:27:1061004024:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我一直有个心底的疑问……

say:28:1061004025:1.text: When you first came to Holistone, you mentioned "Fairy Tail". Can you tell me more about it?
say:28:1061004025:1.source_cn: 你们刚到圣石镇时也提到过妖精的尾巴这个名字，那到底是怎...

say:29:1061004026:1.text: Like I said earlier, it's less of a guild, more of a family! But let me expand on that.
say:29:1061004026:1.source_cn: 与其说公会，不如说是个大家庭！

say:30:1061004027:1.text: Our guildmates aren't just comrades in name—they're bonds of the heart, people you can trust unconditionally.
say:30:1061004027:1.source_cn: 是的，这里的家人不是言语上，是心之所属，可以无条件信任...

say:31:1061004028:1.text: Through joy and sorrow, we stand together.
say:31:1061004028:1.source_cn: 欢乐也好，痛苦也罢，都会相互陪伴。

say:32:1061004029:1.text: No matter where we go, we're never alone. We can always face tomorrow with hope in our hearts!
say:32:1061004029:1.source_cn: 无论到哪里都不再孤身一人，我们可以随时心怀希望，奔向明天！

say:33:1061004030:1.text: It's a place where the adventure begins, carried by the song of fairies.
say:33:1061004030:1.source_cn: 那是个，随时能和妖精的歌声一起启程的地方！

choice_prompt:35:1061004031.source_cn: 总之，有伙伴的地方，就是妖精的尾巴！

say:38:1061004032:0.text: Indeed. A place where all are welcome, just like this place.
say:38:1061004032:0.source_cn: 没错，像是和神秘屋一样，能把大家都聚齐的温暖的地方。

say:39:1061004033:0.text: Anyway, Lucy, how do we get back to the guild? Got any ideas?
say:39:1061004033:0.source_cn: 说起来，露西，我们怎样回公会呢？你有什么办法吗？

say:43:1061004035:0.text: The gate I opened only connects to the Spirit World. Sending you two back to Earth Land will require another method.
say:43:1061004035:0.source_cn: 我打开的星灵之门只能回星灵界，要把你们送回阿斯兰特需要...

say:44:1061004036:0.text: What?! Not even Aquarius can do it?! Are we stuck here forever?!
say:44:1061004036:0.source_cn: 什么……连阿葵亚也没有办法吗……那我们岂不是回不去了！

say:47:1061004037:0.text: Actually, I meant to say this earlier—I tried tracking the magical energy around you two, and it led me to a really distant space. I think... that might be your original world.
say:47:1061004037:0.source_cn: 我其实刚才就想说，我试着追溯你们身上的魔力，追溯到一个...

say:48:1061004038:0.text: But I don't have enough magic power to open a portal that spans two dimensions. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think... you could help me?
say:48:1061004038:0.source_cn: 但我的魔力还不足以开启链接两个空间的传送门。<styl...
say:48:1061004038:0.male: But I don't have enough magic power to open a portal that spans two dimensions. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think... you could help me?
say:48:1061004038:0.female: But I don't have enough magic power to open a portal that spans two dimensions. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think... you could help me?

choice_prompt:49:1061004031.source_cn: 总之，有伙伴的地方，就是妖精的尾巴！

say:50:1061004039:0.text: T-The portal opened just like that...? What was I even stressing over earlier...?
say:50:1061004039:0.source_cn: 传、传送门就这样被打开了……？所以我刚才在苦恼什么……

say:51:1061004040:0.text: As expected of <style="stress"><player_name></style>—you made it look easy! Natsu, Lucy, hurry! The portal won't stay open for long!
say:51:1061004040:0.male: As expected of <style="stress"><player_name></style>—you made it look easy! Natsu, Lucy, hurry! The portal won't stay open for long!
say:51:1061004040:0.female: As expected of <style="stress"><player_name></style>—you made it look easy! Natsu, Lucy, hurry! The portal won't stay open for long!

say:52:1061004041:0.text: We're already saying goodbye? That was way too fast!
say:52:1061004041:0.source_cn: 呃， 这么快就要和各位说再见了！

say:53:1061004042:0.text: Farewell... *Sniff* I hope we'll meet again.
say:53:1061004042:0.source_cn: 再见……呜呜……希望还能和大家见面。

narration:55:1061004043:0.text: Aquarius, Lucy, and Natsu step through the gate, vanishing from sight.
narration:55:1061004043:0.source_cn: 阿葵亚、露西与纳兹走进了星灵之门，消失在众人的视野中

narration:56:1061004044:0.text: The Mystical House feels quieter without Natsu and Lucy. But before long, Valen's jokes break the silence—filling the room with warmth and laughter once more.
narration:56:1061004044:0.source_cn: 神秘屋少了纳兹与露西的身影显得有些落寂，不过很快被维伦...

narration:57:1061004045:0.text: Cassadee's diary ends today on a rare note—nothing about magic this time. Instead, she writes:
narration:57:1061004045:0.source_cn: 科丝蒂今天的日记结尾难得与讨论魔法无关，这样写道：

narration:58:1061004046:0.text: Every journey's an adventure when you've got friends you trust. With them by your side, there's nothing to be afraid of.
narration:58:1061004046:0.source_cn: 每次启程都是一次华丽的冒险，有信赖的伙伴在身旁的时候，...

narration:59:1061004047:0.text: So keep that hope close, and head out again when you're ready!

narration:60:1061004048:0.text: You're always welcome back, Natsu and Lucy.
narration:60:1061004048:0.source_cn: 随时欢迎你们回来，纳兹，露西

choice:49:0:1.text: I'll use my magic to open a portal!
choice:49:0:1.male: I'll use my magic to open a portal!
choice:49:0:1.female: I'll use my magic to open a portal!

say:62:1061004005:1.text: Are we doing goodbye speeches already? I'm not emotionally prepared!
say:62:1061004005:1.source_cn: 啊，要提前说告别语了吗？我还没准备好……
